nodes.label: ADR: Chunk Loading Strategy
nodes.rationale: Chunk generation is CPU-heavy and cannot block the game loop. GPU upload requires main thread (OpenGL is not thread-safe), so results flow as Ready records from background threads to Game on main thread.

nodes.label: ADR: Chunk Rendering Approach
nodes.rationale: GLSL inlined as Java strings avoids path issues at different CWDs and keeps diffs readable in git. centroid out vec2 vUv prevents MSAA UV extrapolation bleeding. Atlas uses GL_NEAREST without mipmaps because tiles are edge-to-edge.

nodes.label: Dual-Mesh Transparent Water Pass
nodes.rationale: Dual-mesh approach chosen over world-wide water buffer (complex cache invalidation) and separate WaterRenderer (over-engineered). Reuses existing chunkShader with blend enabled.

nodes.label: com.mineclone.save Package (SaveManager, LevelData, ChunkSnapshot, Options)
nodes.rationale: All disk I/O isolated in one package so engine depends only on API. Whole-chunk snapshot chosen over per-block delta to eliminate cross-chunk water re-simulation ordering hazard.

nodes.label: Day/Night Cycle (uDaylight Uniform)
nodes.rationale: Approach B: existing aLight bakes AO+face+sky; new aBlockLight float attribute carries torch light; uDaylight uniform (0-1) scales sky so nights go dark without rebuilding meshes.

nodes.label: Health System (HP, Fall Damage, MLG, Regen)
nodes.rationale: Approach A: all health/fall logic in Player.java. Game.java only reads player.isDead() and changes state to DEAD.

nodes.label: MC-Like Ground Movement (Exponential Accel)
nodes.rationale: Exponential approach (1 - exp(-rate*dt)) is dt-independent and gives GROUND_ACCEL=14 for ground and AIR_ACCEL=2.5 for air, matching MC feel.

nodes.label: MenuBackground (Dedicated Mini-World + Orbit Camera)
nodes.rationale: Fixed MENU_SEED world with orbit camera that samples terrainTop height so camera never clips even if seed or generator changes.

nodes.label: Chunk Modified Flag (Post-Generation Edits)
nodes.rationale: Single modified boolean preferred over per-block delta to avoid cross-chunk water re-simulation ordering hazards. Generation uses Chunk.set directly so generated chunks stay modified=false.

nodes.label: Stone-Textured Beveled Menu Buttons
nodes.rationale: Uses atlas STONE tile + tint factor instead of separate PNG files, keeping atlas as source of truth and avoiding extra assets.

nodes.label: New World Flow (Confirm Dialog, Delete Save, Relaunch)
nodes.rationale: Forced relaunch chosen over hot-swapping World instance mid-process to avoid de-finalizing 4-5 fields in Game and tearing down mesh maps.
